scripts.lint: biome check . && prettier --check "**/*.{md,markdown,yaml,yml}" && uv tool run ruff@latest check . && uv tool run ruff@latest format --check .
scripts.format: biome format --write . && prettier --write "**/*.{md,markdown,yaml,yml}" && uv tool run ruff@latest format .
scripts.typecheck: if [ -d src ]; then tsc --noEmit; else echo 'no src/ yet, nothing to typecheck'; fi
scripts.test: uv run --with pytest --with "psycopg[binary]" python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:all: bun run test && cd web && bun install && bun run test
